title: Mum's Middle — EN/IT/DE (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 96bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling English Italian German language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The middle child gets good at watching
You learn to read a room before you speak
Corey never rushed the conversation
Just waited till it mattered and said it clean

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
Trovò l'oceano a modo suo [He found the ocean in his own sweet time]
Non il rugby come suo fratello, quello non era mai suo [Not rugby like his brother, that was never his]
Ma dagli aria salata e una mattina aperta [But give him salt air and an open morning]
È allora che vedo il mio figlio di mezzo in libertà [That's when I see my middle boy at ease]

[Chorus — English]
My middle one, the one who found his own
My middle one, the one who made a home
Not louder than the others, not behind
My middle one — you were exactly right

[Bridge — Deutsch]
Er hat mich einmal von irgendwo nahe dem Wasser angerufen [He rang me once from somewhere near the water]
Er sagte — Mama, ich glaube, ich habe es herausgefunden [He said — Mum, I think I've worked it out]
Ich sagte — Liebling, das hast du mit sieben herausgefunden [I said — love, you worked it out at seven]
Du brauchtest nur Zeit, um dir selbst zu erlauben zu glauben [You just needed time to let yourself believe]

[Verse 3 — English]
He sends me music now and asks what I think
And I listen in the garden with my cup of tea

[Outro — EN/IT/DE]
The gardens still growing
Il giardino sta ancora crescendo [The garden is still growing]
Der Garten wächst noch [The garden is still growing]
My middle one
